command:
set -eu
command -v ip
command -v python3
! sudo -n ip netns list | grep -q '^ufwtest '
! ip link show ufwtest-host >/dev/null 2>&1
sudo -n ip netns add ufwtest
sudo -n ip link add ufwtest-host type veth peer name ufwtest-peer
sudo -n ip link set ufwtest-peer netns ufwtest
sudo -n ip addr add 198.18.0.1/30 dev ufwtest-host
sudo -n ip link set ufwtest-host up
sudo -n ip netns exec ufwtest ip addr add 198.18.0.2/30 dev ufwtest-peer
sudo -n ip netns exec ufwtest ip link set lo up
sudo -n ip netns exec ufwtest ip link set ufwtest-peer up
nohup python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0 >/tmp/ufw-test-8080.log 2>&1 & printf '%s\n' "$!" | sudo -n tee /run/ufw-test-8080.pid >/dev/null
nohup python3 -m http.server 9090 --bind 0.0.0.0 >/tmp/ufw-test-9090.log 2>&1 & printf '%s\n' "$!" | sudo -n tee /run/ufw-test-9090.pid >/dev/null
sleep 1
sudo -n ss -lntp '( sport = :8080 or sport = :9090 )'
sudo -n ip netns exec ufwtest ip -4 addr show dev ufwtest-peer
